newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo feeder cattle steady-up $2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo feeder cattle steady-up $2 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to $2.00 per cwt higher, compared to last week, USDA said. Bulk supply Medium and Large 1-2 400-800 lb feeder steers and heifers. Trade moderate. Demand good.
Feeder steers and heifers under 600 lbs 36 percent, over 600 lbs 57 percent with cows and bulls around 7 percent of total supply.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 500-600 lbs 85.00-89.00; few 600-650 lbs 79.50-85.50, two part loads 600-685 lbs fleshy 76.50-77.00; 700-800 lbs 76.00-79.75, part load 705 lbs fleshy 74.40; lot 875 lbs fleshy 71.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - 600-700 lbs 75.00-76.50; lot 793 lbs 70.00. Small and Medium 1-2 - 500-600 lbs 75.00-79.50.

Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600- 700 lbs 73.75-78.00, two lots 650-680 lbs fleshy 68.00-69.25; 700-800 lbs 74.00-75.70, lot 715 lbs fleshy 68.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - 600-800 lbs 67.50-72.50. Small and Medium 1-2 - lot 328 lbs 82.50; pkg 477 lbs 72.50. Receipts - 2,135 Week Ago - 2,466 Year Ago - 1,959
